description: Use this when someone asks for their Moon sign (rashi), birth star or nakshatra and pada in Vedic astrology. Also use for "birth star", "janma nakshatra", "what is my rashi", "my zodiac sign in Vedic astrology". Works from the birth date and town; the time makes it exact when the Moon changes sign that day. Do not use for Western sun signs, horoscopes or the rising sign.

birth_place.description: Town or city of birth, with region or country if known, e.g. "Chicago, Illinois, US" or "Pune, India".

birth_time.description: Local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. 13:35. As exact as possible (from a birth certificate).

name: moon_sign_nakshatra
title: Moon sign and nakshatra
